description: Which USDA AMS daily cash grain bid reports exist, which state and commodities each covers, and how fresh each is. FREE. Call before cash.bids to learn which states are covered and which reports have stopped publishing: liveness is current, stale (served and flagged), unlisted (AMS no longer lists it) or unknown. Three reports are published as covered-but-unparsed rather than omitted, because a visible gap beats a silent absence.
